messages:
mina (Eng): Quick Q - I'm scheduled to have a foster placement next Monday. If it converts to adoption later, do I need to refile paperwork? Also curious about the process for requesting additional top-up weeks beyond the standard paid parental leave.

ria (People Ops): Congrats! If placement is 'with intent to adopt' it's the same parental/adoption workflow. You should submit the placement letter and select Parental - Adoption/Foster in Workday. If it later converts to adoption, no need to refile, but upload the adoption decree when available. For top-up beyond standard: submit Family Leave Top-Up form and manager approval; approvals are case-by-case and budget contingent.

oliver (Manager): From manager side: open to approving top-up weeks if there's a clear plan and budget. Ria, what's the typical approval turnaround?

ria (People Ops): Usually 5 business days once docs are in; faster if urgent and we have budget signoff. We can tentatively approve pending budget for short time-sensitive cases.

helen (Payroll): For payroll coding include the leave code in Workday and CC payroll@redwood.com on the upload so we can set up pay entries. We can do retro payments within a month if paperwork lags.

mina (Eng): Thanks everyone. Uploading docs now and will DM Ria for the top-up form.

ria (People Ops): Sending the form and a short checklist via DM. We'll coordinate with Payroll and your manager for coverage. Good luck and congrats again! :tada:
